outsideSubmissionPitch.subject: Outside Submission / Patent Licensing Review: Self-Cleaning Shovel (U.S. Prov. Pat. 64/035,114)
outsideSubmissionPitch.body:
Dear Bully Tools New Product Development & Licensing,

I am writing to submit an outside product licensing inquiry regarding a patented commercial hand tool innovation: the Self-Cleaning, Self-Standing Jobsite Shovel (protected under U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 64/035,114).

Field trials on commercial jobsites confirm that mud, soil, and clay adhesion increases user fatigue and slows digging cycle times by over 20%. Our design incorporates a mechanical release geometry that completely eliminates soil adhesion without adding moving failure points, while retaining full structural contractor-grade durability.

A complete technical demonstration, utility specifications, and field video can be reviewed directly at:
👉 https://selfcleaningshovel.tiiny.site

We are currently evaluating outside submission agreements and exclusive manufacturing licensing / patent buyout opportunities with established tool brands like Bully Tools. We would welcome the opportunity to execute your standard Outside Submission Agreement or Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and schedule a brief 15-minute technical review call with your engineering and product licensing team.

Please let me know your preferred procedure for outside submission review.

Sincerely,
Jack Bockholdt
Inventor & Patent Holder
U.S. Provisional Patent No. 64/035,114
Missed Call Project / Master Hustle Engine
Email: jbockholdt4@gmail.com
Direct: (217) 609-1305
Interactive Demo: https://selfcleaningshovel.tiiny.site
